activity_summary: You came home for a clean band. You said Westminster, by water, and you did not bring a name into the house. Alse pinned it. Mistress Ansell did not take the parlour as a reason to go to a play again. You said you would be late, and that you would not wake the stair.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the river and not the guest.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Gave the band, and refused a second playgoing.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Pinned it, and did not ask about boys.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The band is clean. I am not asking where a clean band goes on a Tuesday.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Westminster, Mistress. By water. I am not bringing you a name to carry into the close.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Once was enough of a play. Another man's parlour is not my second time.
